Maya (CSM): Quick thread 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 
WillowHealth wants to shorten renewal to 9 months and true-down from 20 -> 15 seats. Procurement requires a new PO + signed amendment before DocuSign.
Evan (WillowHealth): Confirmed. CFO approved 9m term. Same per-seat rate. We'll provide PO referencing original contract 7492-RED.
Tom (Finance): net30 ok. PO must include billing entity name, vendor_code (our side), and tax ID. PDF preferred.
Maya (CSM): Sample PO payload I accept: {"po_number":"<PO#>", "billing_entity":"WillowHealth, Inc.", "vendor_code":"<vendor_code>", "amount":"<USD>", "term_months":"9", "tax_id":"<EIN>"} Fill vendor_code/tax and attach.
Evan (WillowHealth): Using vendor_code 8491-US (US entity). Tax ID 12-3456789. PO ETA: tomorrow EOD. Will reference Amendment v2.
Nina (Legal): I'll draft Amendment v2 (term + seat reduction + proration). Need counterparty legal contact to speed review. If they can turn redlines in 48h we can meet billing cutoff.
Evan (WillowHealth): Looping Jess Carter (jess.carter@willowhealth.com) now.
Diego (Onboarding): I'll remove 5 seats from training roster and rebook remaining 15. Suggest enablement week-of-21. I'll set entitlement change to take effect 1st of next month after PO clears to avoid mid-cohort drops.
Maya (CSM): Action list: Nina draft amendment; Evan send PO PDF with vendor_code & tax; Tom confirmed net30; Diego schedule enablement; I will open DocuSign once docs attached.
docusign-bot: Envelope placeholder created 1 EnvelopeID: ef123456 status: awaiting signatures. Link: https://docusign.example/ef123456
Maya (CSM): Recap 705: Evan sends PO tomorrow; Nina finalizes amendment and sends to Jess; I'll update Gainsight with new term/seats and post final checklist here.
Evan (WillowHealth): Thanks all. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
